name: Deryan’s Helpful Homunculi

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

components.m: gemstone powder worth 100 GP, consumed, and Artisan’s Tools you are proficient with

summary: Tiny intangible helpers, proficient in Arcana and in the Artisan's Tools you used to cast the spell, assist you for 8 hours: they count as one crafting assistant and halve crafting time. The game has no crafting yet, so this is played at the table.
